canonical_question.en: Can I drink river water?

en: Is river water safe to drink?
Can I use river water for drinking?
Can people drink water from the river?
shona: Zvakanaka here kunwa mvura inobva murwizi?

answer_short.en: River water may contain germs and should not be drunk before treatment.
answer_short.shona: Mvura yerwizi inogona kuva nemasimu uye haifaniri kunwiwa isati yarapwa.

en: If the water is dirty, filter it first with a clean cloth or sand filter.
Boil it for at least 1 minute or treat it with chlorine.
Store it in a clean, covered container.
shona: Kana mvura yakasviba, tanga waisefa nejira rakachena kana sefa yejecha.
Bika kweminiti imwe kana kuirapa nechlorine.

answer_warning.en: Do not drink untreated river water.
answer_warning.shona: Usanwa mvura yerwizi isina kurapwa.

follow_up_question.en: Is the water clear or dirty?
follow_up_question.shona: Mvura yacho yakachena here kana yakasviba?

canonical_question.en: If water looks clean, is it safe?
canonical_question.shona: Kana mvura ichiita seyakachena, yakachengeteka here?

en: Can I drink water that looks clean?
Is clear water always safe?
If water is clear, is it okay to drink?
shona: Mvura yakajeka inenge yakachengeteka nguva dzose here?
Kana mvura yakachena pameso, zvakanaka kuiwa here?

answer_short.en: No. Water can look clean but still carry invisible germs.
answer_short.shona: Kwete. Mvura inogona kutaridzika yakachena asi ichine masimu asingaonekwi.

en: Boil or treat the water before drinking it.
Keep treated water in a clean, covered container.
shona: Bika kana kurapa mvura usati wanwa.
Chengeta mvura yarapwa mumudziyo wakachena wakafukidzwa.

answer_warning.en: Do not assume clear water is safe.
answer_warning.shona: Usafunge kuti mvura yakajeka yakachengeteka.

canonical_question.en: How can I treat water at home?

en: How do I make water safe at home?
What can I use to treat water at home?
How should I clean drinking water at home?
shona: Ndoita sei kuti mvura ive yakachengeteka pamba?
Ndinonatsa sei mvura yekunwa ndiri pamba?

answer_short.en: You can boil water, use chlorine, or filter it to make it safer for drinking.
answer_short.shona: Munogona kubika mvura, kuisa chlorine, kana kuisefa kuti ive yakachengeteka kunwiwa.

en: If the water is cloudy, filter it first through a clean cloth.
Boil for at least 1 minute or add the correct amount of chlorine.
Let it cool and store it in a clean, covered container.
shona: Kana mvura ine tsvina, tanga waisefa nejira rakachena.
Bika kweminiti imwe kana kuisa chlorine yakaringana.
Rega itonhore woichengeta mumudziyo wakachena wakavharwa.

answer_warning.en: Do not store treated water in a dirty container.
answer_warning.shona: Usachengete mvura yarapwa mumudziyo une tsvina.

canonical_question.en: Why should I boil water?

en: Why is boiling water important?
Does boiling water help?
Why do people boil drinking water?

answer_short.en: Boiling helps kill many germs that can make people sick.
answer_short.shona: Kubika kunobatsira kuuraya masimu mazhinji anokonzera kurwara.

en: Bring the water to a full boil.
Keep it boiling for at least 1 minute.
Cool it and keep it in a clean container.
shona: Isa mvura pamoto kusvikira yabubura zvakanaka.

answer_warning.en: Boiling does not help if dirty water is stored again in an unclean container.
answer_warning.shona: Kubika hakubatsiri kana mvura yadzoswa mumudziyo usina kuchena.

canonical_question.en: How long should I boil water?
canonical_question.shona: Ndinofanira kubika mvura kwenguva yakareba sei?

en: How many minutes should I boil water?
How long do I keep water boiling?
For how much time should water boil?
shona: Ndinorega mvura ichibika kwenguva yakareba sei?

answer_short.en: Boil water for at least 1 minute. In very high places, boil it for 3 minutes.
answer_short.shona: Bika mvura kweminiti imwe. Kunzvimbo dzakakwirira zvikuru, bika kwemaminitsi matatu.

answer_warning.en: Do not drink water that has not boiled long enough.
answer_warning.shona: Usanwa mvura isina kubikwa nguva yakakwana.

canonical_question.en: Is my water safe to drink?

en: How do I know if water is safe?
Is this water okay to drink?
Can I tell if my water is safe?
shona: Pane nzira here yekuziva kana mvura yakachengeteka?

answer_short.en: Water is safer to drink after it has been boiled or treated and kept in a clean container.
answer_short.shona: Mvura inonyanya kuchengeteka kunwiwa kana yabikwa kana kurapwa yobva yachengetwa mumudziyo wakachena.

en: Check where the water comes from.
If you are not sure, boil or treat it before drinking.
Store it in a clean, covered container.
shona: Tarisa kuti mvura iri kubva kupi.
Kana usina chokwadi, bika kana kuirapa usati wanwa.

answer_warning.en: Water from rivers, dams, and dirty containers may not be safe without treatment.
answer_warning.shona: Mvura yerwizi, yedhamu, kana iri mumudziyo une tsvina haigoni kuvimbwa nayo isina kurapwa.

follow_up_question.en: Are you using river water, borehole water, or dam water?
follow_up_question.shona: Muri kushandisa mvura yerwizi, yemugodhi, kana yedhamu?

canonical_question.en: Is water from Matezva Dam safe to drink?
canonical_question.shona: Mvura yeMatezva Dam yakachengeteka kunwiwa here?

en: Can I drink Matezva Dam water?
Is Matezva water safe?
Do I need to treat water from Matezva Dam?
shona: Mvura inobva kuMatezva Dam inofanira kurapwa here?

answer_short.en: Water from Matezva Dam should always be treated before drinking because it may be contaminated.
answer_short.shona: Mvura yeMatezva Dam inofanira kugara yarapwa isati yanwiwa nokuti inogona kunge ine tsvina.

en: If it is cloudy, filter it first.
Boil it or treat it with chlorine.
Store it in a clean container with a cover.

answer_warning.en: Do not drink Matezva Dam water without treatment.
answer_warning.shona: Usanwa mvura yeMatezva Dam isina kurapwa.

canonical_question.en: Why does water sometimes look green?
canonical_question.shona: Sei mvura dzimwe nguva ichiita girinhi?

en: Why is my water green?
Green water means what?
Is green water safe to drink?
shona: Mvura iri girinhi yakachengeteka kunwiwa here?

answer_short.en: Green water may have algae or other contamination and should be treated before drinking.
answer_short.shona: Mvura yegirinhi inogona kuva nealgae kana imwe tsvina, saka inofanira kurapwa isati yanwiwa.

en: Do not drink it straight away.
If possible, find a cleaner source.
If you must use it, filter and boil or treat it first.
shona: Kana zvichibvira, tsvagai imwe mvura iri nani.
Kana muchifanira kuishandisa, sefani wobva waibika kana kuiuraya nechlorine.

answer_warning.en: Green or discoloured water should never be trusted without treatment.
answer_warning.shona: Mvura yegirinhi kana yakashanduka ruvara haifaniri kuvimbwa nayo isina kurapwa.

canonical_question.en: Why does water smell bad or taste strange?
canonical_question.shona: Sei mvura ichinhuwa kana kuravira zvisina kujairika?

en: My water smells funny.
Why does water taste bad?
What does it mean when water smells strange?
shona: Mvura yangu iri kunhuwa zvisina kujairika.

answer_short.en: A bad smell or strange taste can mean the water has contamination.
answer_short.shona: Kunhuwa kana kuravira kusina kujairika kunogona kuratidza kuti mvura ine tsvina.

en: Avoid drinking it as it is.
Try to use another source if one is available.
If there is no other source, treat it and ask a health worker for advice.
shona: Kana pasina imwe, rapai mvura uye bvunzai mushandi weutano.

answer_warning.en: Do not drink water that smells or tastes unusual without caution.
answer_warning.shona: Usanwa mvura inonhuwa kana kuravira zvisina kujairika pasina kungwarira.

canonical_question.en: Can mining activities affect water quality?
canonical_question.shona: Migodhi inogona kukanganisa kunaka kwemvura here?

en: Does mining pollute water?
Can mines make water unsafe?
Is water near mines safe?
shona: Migodhi inogona kuita kuti mvura isa chengeteke here?
Mvura iri pedyo nemigodhi yakachengeteka here?

answer_short.en: Yes. Mining can release harmful substances into nearby water sources.
answer_short.shona: Hongu. Migodhi inogona kusvitsa zvinhu zvinokuvadza mumvura iri pedyo.

en: Avoid using water close to mining areas if you can.
Treat any water before drinking it.
Report unusual colour, smell, or illness to local health workers.
shona: Dzivisai kushandisa mvura iri pedyo nemigodhi kana zvichibvira.
Mhan'arai ruvara, kunhuwa, kana kurwara zvisina kujairika kumushandi weutano.

answer_warning.en: Water near mining areas may be unsafe even if it looks clean.
answer_warning.shona: Mvura iri pedyo nemigodhi inogona kusava yakachengeteka kunyange ichitaridzika yakachena.

canonical_question.en: What are germs in water?

en: What lives in dirty water?
Are there germs in water?
What makes water carry disease?
shona: Chii chinoita kuti mvura itakure chirwere?

answer_short.en: Germs are tiny living things in dirty water that can cause disease.
answer_short.shona: Masimu zvinhu zvidiki zvikuru zviri mumvura ine tsvina zvinogona kukonzera chirwere.

answer_warning.en: You cannot always see germs with your eyes.
answer_warning.shona: Masimu haawanzoonekwa nemeso.

canonical_question.en: What is E. coli?

en: What is E. coli in water?
Why do people talk about E. coli?
Is E. coli dangerous?

answer_short.en: E. coli is a germ from faeces that can get into water and make people sick.
answer_short.shona: E. coli isimusi rinobva mutsvina yemunhu kana yemhuka rinogona kupinda mumvura rikakonzera kurwara.

en: Use a toilet and keep waste away from water.
Boil or treat water before drinking it.
Wash hands after using the toilet.
shona: Shandisai chimbuzi uye chengetai tsvina kure nemvura.
Bikai kana kurapa mvura musati mainwa.

answer_warning.en: Water with faecal contamination can spread serious illness.
answer_warning.shona: Mvura ine tsvina yemuzvimbuzi inogona kuparadzira chirwere chakakomba.

canonical_question.en: How does water become contaminated?

en: How does water get dirty?
What makes water unsafe?
How does contamination enter water?
shona: Chii chinoita kuti mvura isa chengeteke?

answer_short.en: Water becomes contaminated when waste, germs, or harmful substances enter it.
answer_short.shona: Mvura inosvibiswa kana tsvina, masimu, kana zvinhu zvinokuvadza zvapinda mairi.

en: Keep toilets and waste away from water sources.
Use clean containers when fetching and storing water.
Treat water if you are not sure it is safe.
shona: Chengetai zvimbuzi netsvina kure nematsime nemvura.
Shandisai midziyo yakachena pakutora nekuchengeta mvura.
Rapai mvura kana musina chokwadi chekuti yakachengeteka.

answer_warning.en: Rain, animals, dirty containers, and open defecation can all contaminate water.
answer_warning.shona: Mvura inogona kusvibiswa nemvura yemvura, mhuka, midziyo ine tsvina, uye kuzvibatsira panze.

canonical_question.en: Can boiling water remove germs?

en: Does boiling kill germs?
Is boiled water free from germs?
Can I make water safer by boiling it?
shona: Mvura yakabikwa inenge isina masimu here?
Ndingaita mvura yakachengeteka nekui bika here?

answer_short.en: Boiling kills many germs and makes water safer to drink.
answer_short.shona: Kubika kunouraya masimu mazhinji uye kunoita mvura ive yakachengeteka kunwiwa.

en: Boil the water fully for at least 1 minute.
Let it cool without adding dirty water.
Store it in a clean, covered container.
shona: Rega itonhore pasina kuwedzera mvura ine tsvina.

answer_warning.en: Boiling does not remove dirt, so filter cloudy water first.
answer_warning.shona: Kubika hakubvisi tsvina inooneka, saka sefa mvura ine makore kutanga.

canonical_question.en: Why is my water cloudy or dirty?
canonical_question.shona: Sei mvura yangu iine makore kana yakasviba?

en: Why is water brown?
What makes water cloudy?
Why does my water look dirty?
shona: Chii chinoita kuti mvura ive nemakore?

answer_short.en: Cloudy or dirty water may contain soil, waste, or germs from the source or the container.
answer_short.shona: Mvura ine makore kana yakasviba inogona kuva neivhu, tsvina, kana masimu kubva kusosi kana mumudziyo.

en: Let heavy dirt settle if possible.
Filter the water with a clean cloth.
Boil or treat it before drinking.
shona: Regai tsvina inorema inyure pasi kana zvichibvira.

answer_warning.en: Cloudy water should not be drunk without cleaning and treatment.
answer_warning.shona: Mvura ine makore haifaniri kunwiwa isina kusefwa nekubikwa kana kurapwa.

follow_up_question.en: Is it very cloudy or only slightly dirty?
follow_up_question.shona: Iine makore mazhinji here kana kuti yakasviba zvishoma?

canonical_question.en: Can I drink cloudy water?

en: Is cloudy water safe?
Should I drink dirty-looking water?
Can brown water be used for drinking?
shona: Zvakanaka here kunwa mvura inoita seyakashata?

answer_short.en: No. Cloudy water should be cleaned and treated before drinking.
answer_short.shona: Kwete. Mvura ine makore inofanira kutanga yacheneswa nekurerapwa isati yanwiwa.

en: Filter it with a clean cloth or sand filter.
Boil it or treat it with chlorine.
Store it in a clean, covered container.
shona: Sefai nejira rakachena kana sefa yejecha.

answer_warning.en: Do not drink cloudy water as it is.
answer_warning.shona: Usanwa mvura ine makore yakadaro.

canonical_question.en: How can I clean dirty water?

en: How do I filter dirty water?
How can I clean cloudy water?
What should I do with dirty water?

answer_short.en: Clean dirty water by filtering it first and then boiling or treating it.
answer_short.shona: Chenesa mvura yakasviba nekuisefa kutanga wobva wai bika kana kui rapa.

en: Pour the water through a clean cloth, or use a sand filter.
Boil it for at least 1 minute or add chlorine.
Keep it in a clean container with a lid.
shona: Dururai mvura nejira rakachena kana kushandisa sefa yejecha.
Bikai kweminiti imwe kana kuisa chlorine.

answer_warning.en: Filtering alone is not enough to make dirty water safe.
answer_warning.shona: Kusefa chete hakukwanisi kuita mvura yakasviba yakachengeteka.

canonical_question.en: My water is dirty, what should I do?

en: I have dirty water.
My water is not clean.
What do I do with dirty water?

answer_short.en: If your water is dirty, clean it first and then treat it before drinking.
answer_short.shona: Kana mvura yenyu yakasviba, tanga maichenesa wobva mairapa musati mainwa.

en: If it is very cloudy, let the dirt settle and filter it with a clean cloth.
Boil it for at least 1 minute or treat it with chlorine.
Store it in a clean, covered container.
shona: Kana iine makore mazhinji, regai tsvina inyure pasi mozosefa nejira rakachena.
Bikai kweminiti imwe kana kuirapa nechlorine.

answer_warning.en: Dirty water can spread disease if it is drunk without treatment.
answer_warning.shona: Mvura yakasviba inogona kuparadzira chirwere kana ikanwiwa isina kurapwa.

follow_up_question.en: Is it very cloudy or just slightly dirty?
follow_up_question.shona: Iine makore mazhinji here kana kuti yakasviba zvishoma?

canonical_question.en: I only use river water, how can I make it safe?
canonical_question.shona: Ndinongoshandisa mvura yerwizi chete, ndingaichengetedza sei?

en: Only river water is available.
How do I make river water safe?
I depend on river water for drinking.
shona: Ndoita sei kuti mvura yerwizi ive yakachengeteka?

answer_short.en: River water can be used only after it has been filtered if dirty and then boiled or treated.
answer_short.shona: Mvura yerwizi inogona kushandiswa chete kana yasefwa kana iine tsvina yobva yabikwa kana kurapwa.

en: If the water is dirty, filter it first.
Boil it for at least 1 minute or add chlorine.
Store it in a clean, covered container.
shona: Bika kweminiti imwe kana kuisa chlorine.

answer_warning.en: Do not depend on untreated river water for drinking.
answer_warning.shona: Usavimba nemvura yerwizi isina kurapwa pakunwa.

follow_up_question.en: Is the river water clear or dirty?
follow_up_question.shona: Mvura yerwizi yacho yakachena here kana yakasviba?

canonical_question.en: What should I do if I do not have clean water?
canonical_question.shona: Ndoita sei kana ndisina mvura yakachena?

en: I have no clean water.
What if clean water is not available?
There is no safe water at home.
shona: Ndoita sei kana mvura yakachena isipo?

answer_short.en: Treat whatever water you have before drinking it.
answer_short.shona: Rapai mvura yamunayo musati mainwa.

en: If the water is cloudy, filter it through a clean cloth.
Boil it for at least 1 minute or use chlorine.
Store it in a clean, covered container.
shona: Kana mvura iine makore, sefani nejira rakachena.
Bikai kweminiti imwe kana kushandisa chlorine.

answer_warning.en: Never drink untreated water, even when you are very thirsty.
answer_warning.shona: Musambonwa mvura isina kurapwa kunyange muchinyanya kuva nenyota.
